notes:
• Sources button: if the source you pick won't play, you're put back on the one you were watching, at the same spot
• If the connection drops mid-play, ValFlix reconnects (or gets a fresh link) and carries on instead of closing
• Stopping at the credits now counts as watched on Trakt/Simkl and moves the TV's Continue Watching row on
• Phones: pauses for calls, and when headphones or Bluetooth disconnect
• New setting: Sources & Playback › Buffer size (Standard, Large, Extra large) for big 4K files on Wi-Fi
